title: README:61 repeats 'names it' with a shifted referent
description:
README:61-62 reads 'getuid() names the account the process runs under and getpwuid_r names it'. The second 'names' means 'resolves the account's name' and 'it' means 'the account', so it reads as a duplicated verb rather than a second step.

Rewrite: 'getuid() names the account the process runs under and getpwuid_r resolves its login name'.

Flagged by the AI-prose lens, which otherwise found nothing in this diff: a grep for leverage/robust/seamless/ensure/utilize/facilitate/comprehensive/furthermore/additionally over the full diff returned zero hits.
